title: Malachi Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Malachi 4: the day that burns as a furnace, the sun of righteousness, and the sending of Elijah the prophet.

questions.text: What is the coming day compared to in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:1 says: Behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace.

questions.text: What will all the proud and all who work wickedness become?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:1 says all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble, and the day that comes will burn them up.

questions.text: What will that day leave of them?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:1 says the day will burn them up so that it leaves them neither root nor branch.

questions.text: What will arise for those who fear Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:2 says that to those who fear his name the sun of righteousness shall arise with healing in its wings.

answers.text: A star out of Jacob and a scepter
A fountain of living water in the desert
The sun of righteousness, with healing in its wings
A shepherd after his own heart

questions.text: How will those who fear his name go out?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:2 says they will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

answers.text: Leaping like calves of the stall

questions.text: What will the wicked be under the soles of their feet?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:3 says they shall tread down the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of their feet in the day that he makes.

questions.text: Whose law are the people told to remember?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:4 says: Remember the law of Moses my servant, even statutes and ordinances.

answers.text: The law of Moses, Yahweh's servant
The law of David the king
The law of Aaron the priest

questions.text: Where was that law commanded for all Israel?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:4 says Yahweh commanded it to Moses in Horeb for all Israel.

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh send before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:5 says: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

questions.text: What will he do when he comes?
questions.explanation: Malachi 4:6 says he will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers.

answers.text: Turn the hearts of the fathers to the children
